notes: Stories defined for Board Certification Verification feature using NPI registry data.

stories.title: Board Certification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define internal data schema for board certification including fields for certification_status, board_name, specialty, certification_date, and verification_source derived from NPI registry response.

stories.title: Board Certification Extraction Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to parse NPI registry API response and extract board certification indicators, mapping taxonomy and credential fields into normalized certification status.

stories.title: Certification Scoring and Classification
stories.description: Implement evaluation logic to classify providers as board certified, not certified, or unknown based on extracted NPI data and defined rules.

stories.title: Evaluation API Integration
stories.description: Integrate board certification results into EvaluateCare facade response so certification status is included in provider evaluation outputs.

stories.title: Board Certification Tests and Validation
stories.description: Create unit tests for extraction and classification logic and integration tests validating certification status appears correctly in EvaluateCare responses.

per_feature.mitigation: Fallback to 'unknown' classification when NPI data is incomplete or ambiguous.

per_measure.mitigation: Surface verification source (NPI registry) explicitly in response to reinforce trust.
